From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Lena Park <lena.park@novushealth.ai>, Alejandro Ruiz <alejandro.ruiz@medicore.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:02:00-04:00
Subject: Joint evaluation charter & action roster — Novus Health POC

Hi Lena, Alejandro —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier. As promised, I’m kicking off a short, focused joint evaluation charter so we can align on success criteria, benchmark methodology, and clear owners for prompts/evals. Goal: confirm decisions this week so engineering can spin up the sandbox and we can keep the close timeline (POC decision by end of Q4).

High-level success criteria (proposed):
- Clinical intent accuracy >= 92% on the annotated sample set (primary)
- Average generation latency (p95) <= 250 ms for 512-token sequences (SLO)
- False-positive rate for triage suggestions < 6% vs. internal adjudicator (safety threshold)
- Human-in-the-loop acceptance >= 85% in two-week trial (usability)

Benchmark plan (attached):
- We’ll run three bench types: closed-set classification on annotated v1, open-ended clinical summarization, and lat bench with realistic request mix.
- Marissa will own bench harness and evaluation artifacts; she’ll produce a reproducible script + dataset splits.
- Priyom will own prompt templates, seed prompts, and convergence tests (prompt robustness).

Proposed immediate asks:
1) Please review the attached MAP template and benchmark spec and add any additional success criteria by EOD Wednesday (2026-09-02).
2) Confirm the two primary Novus stakeholders who will adjudicate clinical acceptability (names + emails).
3) Can you grant a read-only dataset drop to redwood-evals@novushealth.ai (we’ll only request sample records, de-identified)?

Tentative owners and timeline (for discussion):
- Prompt owner: Priyom Das (redwood) — prepare seed set by 2026-09-07
- Benchmark harness: Marissa Cole (redwood) — initial run by 2026-09-14
- Results dashboard & alerts: Neha Kapoor (redwood) — dashboard skeleton by 2026-09-10

I’ve attached the MAP template and benchmark spec. If that aligns, let’s lock a 45-minute kickoff tomorrow at 11:00 AM ET to walk through the template and assign Novus-side owners.

Attachments: novus_map_template_v1.xlsx (MAP template), novus_benchmark_spec_v2.pdf (bench details)

Thanks — look forward to aligning.

—
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0192

2) Data access — we can provide a de-identified sample slice, but Novus legal needs a short statement of how Redwood will handle that data (processing + retention).

- Dr. Lena Park (lena.park@novushealth.ai) — Clinical lead (will adjudicate)
